description: This file contains functions to generate absolute redirect URLs for event types, handling different user and team migration states, sub-team structures, and embed support.

methods.name: getUserAndEventTypeSlug
methods.description: Parses the event type redirect URL to extract team slug, event type slug, and username based on URL structure.

methods.name: getAbsoluteEventTypeRedirectUrl
methods.description: Generates a full redirect URL for an event type, considering migration states, sub-teams, and embed mode.

methods.name: getAbsoluteEventTypeRedirectUrlWithEmbedSupport
methods.description: Wrapper around getAbsoluteEventTypeRedirectUrl to include embed support.
